Desirable: Additional training or certification in safeguarding, psychosocial support, conflict resolution, or case management. Desirable: Experience in a UN or international organization, particularly in safeguarding, protection from sexual exploitation, abuse and harassment (PSEAH), or victim/survivor support. Experience in data analysis, reporting, training development, or capacity building related to safeguarding, staff well-being, or misconduct prevention and response.
